## Outcome
Merge board-created pull requests one at a time through fresh guarded gates.

## Scope
Read:
- Accepted T060 and T070 receipts
- Fresh pull-request SHA, dependency, CI, review, scope, and audit state

Write:
- T080-approved merge, reconciliation, recovery, receipt, contract, and tests
- One board-created pull request at a time in github.com/Vel-Labs/orcastrata-max

## Non-goals
- Auto-merge
- Scheduled merge
- Force push
- Unrelated pull requests

## Acceptance criteria
- Each merge occurs once only when current bindings and all required gates pass.

## Validation
- `VAL-T080` — Run stale-state and unknown-outcome tests plus exact-repository guarded merge canaries. → All selected checks pass.

## Dependencies
- T060
- T070

## Stop condition
Stop on stale SHA, dependency drift, conflict, failed CI, review, scope, audit, or unreconciled outcome.

## Orcastrata state
- Work item: `T080`
- GoalBuddy status: `queued`
